description: Late 1st CE nucleated roadside settlement. Expansion in the 3rd CE included a polygonal masonry building that has been interpreted as a shrine. Uncertain how long the structure lasted, but the settlement has evidence for early Saxon settlement and thought to have lasted until the early 5th CE.
bibliography: Allen, Martyn, Tom Brindle, Alex Smith, Julian D Richards, Tim Evans, Neil Holbrook, Michael Fulford, and Nathan Blick. “The Rural Settlement of Roman Britain: An Online Resource.” Archaeology Data Service, 2015. https://doi.org/10.5284/1030449.
